details.note: Matches the mission's documented pre-existing baseline rather than a regression introduced by file-cleanup work.

blockingIssues.description: Deleted-script references still remain after the cleanup feature, so VAL-FC-004 is not satisfied.

appliedUpdates.description: Added .factory/library/file-cleanup-validation.md with the file-layout nuance for NEW_LYRICS, current validation baselines, and the remaining deleted-script residue found during scrutiny.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When a mission intentionally splits deletion and reference cleanup into separate features, the skill should tell workers to follow feature boundaries rather than treating the follow-up cleanup as missing work in the deletion feature.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The remove-narrative-files review noted that the skill's generic deletion procedure expects same-feature reference cleanup, while this mission split that work into remove-narrative-files and cleanup-file-references.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Require workers to reconcile feature verification steps with the validation contract before handoff so required suites are not omitted from recorded evidence.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: The cleanup-file-references review flagged that the worker handoff did not document test_myth_bridge even though VAL-FC-005 requires it.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Avoid broad advice to exclude .opencode/ from dead-reference searches; maintained skill files can still contain stale repository references and should be triaged case-by-case.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: .opencode/skills/simulation-ops/SKILL.md still references deleted part64/SIMULATION_WORKFLOW.md, which was missed when the worker treated .opencode/ as out-of-scope.

rejectedObservations.observation: The cleanup-file-references review marked missing handoff evidence for test_myth_bridge as a blocking issue.
rejectedObservations.reason: Superseded by current scrutiny validation: python3 -m code.tests.test_myth_bridge was executed during this review and passed, so the milestone's current VAL-FC-005 test requirement is satisfied even though the original handoff evidence was incomplete.
